newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK INDUSTRY MIN MEETS WITH BUSINESSMEN OVER BALKANS.
newsitem.headline: GREEK INDUSTRY MIN MEETS WITH BUSINESSMEN OVER BALKANS.

text.p: Greek Industry Minister Vasso Papandreou met today with prominent businessmen and discussed developments in the Balkans, the ministry said in a statement.
It was the third consecutive meeting between the minister and the businessmen in a bid to better coordinate government and industry efforts, it said.

Businessmen Vardis Vardinoyiannis, Socrates Kokkalis, Nikos Grigoriadis representing the Latsis group, Dionysis Kopelouzos and the top management of state Public Petroleum Corporation (DEP) and Public Power Corporation (DEH) were present at the meeting.
